title: Bah, Humbug!: The Story of Charles Dickens' 'A Christmas Carol'
overview: An abridged dramatic reading of Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol", performed live at the Pierpont Morgan Library in New York, and based on Dickens's own adaptation for his dramatic readings.
